verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since Stripe Treasury is an embedded-finance product built on partner banks. The evidence only glancingly supports the story. Stripe offers an embeddable disclosure component that auto-displays compliant disclosure text, which plausibly includes bank-partner information but does not explicitly say so. Separately, a community report of the Evolve Bank breach affecting Stripe Treasury implies Evolve is one sponsor bank. Missing for 10: first-party documentation naming the charter-holding partner bank(s), a clear statement of Stripe's role (direct program vs. middleware), and an explanation of what happens to customer funds if Stripe or the bank fails (e.g., deposit insurance or ledger reconciliation).
